item.title: Venezuela’s new leader calls for opening oil industry to foreign investment and warmer US ties

item.title: Bitter cold temps present challenges for Wilmington’s unsheltered population
item.description: With temperatures expected to be bitterly cold Thursday night and more cold, overnight temperatures expected through the weekend, it's often easy to forget that while many of us have a warm, safe place to sleep at night, that's not the case for some.
